categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Wanyi Science and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four business segments: industrial detection instruments and solutions, online monitoring instruments and solutions, laboratory analysis instruments and solutions, and medical instruments and solutions. These segments focus on the development, manufacturing, and sales of precision scientific instruments based on spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, and chromatography technologies, serving various industries including new energy, biomedicine, automotive manufacturing, environmental protection, and healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include ultra-low emission online monitoring based on spectral technology, VOCs analysis, modulated light source colorimetric water quality detection, micro-trace gas detection and sealing performance measurement based on mass spectrometry, multi-platform intelligent analysis software, ultrasonic energy control for minimally invasive surgical devices, high-pressure constant flow chromatography pump technology, gas chromatography control and detection, quadrupole mass spectrometry, Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, and fully automatic online ion chromatography. Production methods emphasize multi-variety small-batch manufacturing with both standard and customized products, supported by integrated product development (IPD) and integrated supply chain (ISC) management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse customer base across industries such as new energy (including lithium batteries and electric vehicles), biomedicine, automotive parts manufacturing, environmental monitoring, chemical industry, power, refrigeration, scientific research, food safety, pharmaceuticals, and healthcare. Key customers include industrial manufacturers, environmental agencies, research institutions, medical facilities, and third-party testing organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: Anhui Wanyi operates primarily in China with significant market presence across regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest. The company has also expanded internationally with business in 23 countries and regions including Ecuador, Peru, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Turkey, Thailand, and Vietnam, and has established overseas offices such as in Thailand to support global market development.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of precision scientific instruments and providing integrated solutions and after-sales services. It also engages in upstream activities through its subsidiaries involved in environmental monitoring and testing services, thus covering a broad spectrum of the value chain in scientific instrumentation and environmental technology.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes technology innovation and R&D investment to maintain product leadership and support domestic substitution of imported high-end scientific instruments. R&D efforts focus on developing core proprietary technologies in spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, chromatography, and medical devices such as ultrasonic surgical instruments and dialysis machines. The company emphasizes digital transformation, quality management, talent development, and expanding both domestic and international markets, with ongoing projects in advanced mass spectrometry, deep learning adaptive ultrasonic surgical tools, and intelligent assembly and detection equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of precision scientific instruments and equipment across its business segments. Additionally, the company earns income from providing operation and maintenance services for online monitoring instruments. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales complemented by distributor channels, with payment terms varying by product and customer credit. The company also benefits from government subsidies and tax incentives related to R&D and environmental technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anhui Wanyi is positioned as a leading domestic high-end scientific instrument manufacturer, competing against imported brands and other listed companies in the industry. While the high-end market is still dominated by foreign brands, the company leverages its strong R&D capabilities and product quality to capture market share, especially in industrial detection, environmental monitoring, laboratory analysis, and emerging medical instrument sectors. The company benefits from national policies promoting domestic substitution and faces increasing international competition and export restrictions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 740.3 million, a 5.92% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.4 million, down 67.11%. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of about 19.82% of revenue. Total assets stood at RMB 1.2 billion with net assets of RMB 792.3 million. Despite short-term profit declines due to macroeconomic factors and high R&D expenses, the company shows a stable financial base and is focused on long-term growth through innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product performance, reliability, and technological innovation as its core competitive advantages. It offers domestically developed, high-precision instruments with proprietary technologies that meet or exceed international standards, enabling import substitution. Its value proposition includes comprehensive solutions tailored to customer needs, strong after-sales service, competitive pricing compared to imported products, and rapid response capabilities. The company also highlights its commitment to quality management, digital transformation, and sustainable development as key differentiators.
